units.summary: New method that returns the highest append ID known to be committed: the last issued ID when no appenders are open, otherwise the lowest open ID minus 1, and 0 when isolation is disabled. compactHeadViewLocked uses it as the eviction watermark, so whether it is correct decides whether late-committed samples get lost.
units.headline: Add committedAppendID: lowest open append ID minus one, else last ID
units.reason: New logic drives the series-eviction watermark; getting it wrong can silently lose samples.
focus: appendsOpenList stays ordered by ascending appendID, so .next is the lowest open ID
closeAppend runs only after samples are written to memSeries, so IDs at or below the watermark really are in the head when the block snapshot is taken
the txRing in hasAppendIDAbove still holds IDs above the watermark at evict time, even after cleanupAppendIDsBelow runs
isolation disabled returns 0, so the ID check does nothing; confirm callers accept the documented risk from concurrent writes

units.summary: New unit test covering committedAppendID: isolation disabled, no appenders, all appenders closed, one or several open appenders, and open reads. It is test-only and the expectations match the ring-list semantics.
units.headline: New test pins committedAppendID semantics across appender states
units.reason: New test only; it cannot change production behavior.
